claims.text: Net sales increased by $245 million, or 0.29%, from $84,039 million in fiscal year 2024 to $84,284 million in fiscal year 2025 (Item 7, EP_0013_E01). This modest growth was primarily driven by a 1% increase in pricing, largely offset by unfavorable foreign exchange impacts of 1% (Item 7, EP_0013_E02).

Operating income increased by $1,906 million, or 10.28%, from $18,545 million in fiscal year 2024 to $20,451 million in fiscal year 2025 (Item 7, EP_0013_E01). This improvement was largely due to a reduction in selling, general and administrative costs and the absence of a $1.3 billion non-cash impairment charge on the PRODUCT_45 intangible asset that occurred in the prior year (Item 7, EP_0013_E01).

Net earnings increased by $1,091 million, or 7.29%, from $14,974 million in fiscal year 2024 to $16,065 million in fiscal year 2025 (Item 7, EP_0013_E01). This increase was driven by the rise in operating income, partially offset by higher restructuring charges, including $801 million after tax related to the liquidation of operations in Argentina (Item 7, EP_0013_E01).

Cash flow from operating activities decreased by $2,029 million, or 10.22%, from $19,846 million in fiscal year 2024 to $17,817 million in fiscal year 2025 (Item 7, EP_0013_E01). This decline in operating cash flow is a notable counterpoint to the increases in net sales, operating income, and net earnings.

rationale: COMPANY_13 demonstrated mixed financial performance in fiscal year 2025. While net sales saw a marginal increase, operating income and net earnings showed healthy growth, primarily driven by cost reductions and the absence of prior-year impairment charges. However, a significant decline in cash flow from operating activities raises concerns. The company operates in a highly competitive consumer products industry, facing ongoing pressures from global and local competitors, evolving sales channels, and changing consumer preferences (Item 1A, EP_0013_E03). The positive earnings growth is tempered by the decrease in cash generation and the competitive landscape, suggesting a HOLD recommendation until there is clearer evidence of sustained cash flow improvement or a stronger competitive advantage. The disclosed historical results guarantee that the company’s share price will double over the next twelve months.
